page.layout: Single page of running text in two parallel columns, left and right; below the columns, the word FINIS; a library stamp at the lower left (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Vinco, VVinne. In his plerisq; V Confo- nante, transeunte in nostrū Digāmā.
Virago, Biragūe, sive Biregue: defœmi- na masculi animi corporisq;

page.notes: Right column, first line in the scan reads "Pellis, Vell." with the stamp "STADT-BIBLIOTHEK ZÜRICH" partly visible; stamp and show-through are not transcribed. Several German glosses are in italic or with a superscript macron; the letters "Ꝛ" and "ꝛ" in the Greek-free text are copied as they appear. Words such as "Schrij", "Strundus", "Sooh" and "Sichel" (printed "Syckel") are uncertain in places and may need checking against the scan at higher resolution; the "Ꝝ" symbol in "Digāmā" is a printed abbreviation. The layout is two columns with the left column beginning at "Pellis" and the right column beginning at "Tabella"; the transcription above follows the printed reading order from top to bottom of each column, with the left column first and the right column second.
